purpose: Secondary H1a analysis of whether the correct abstract engineering procedure appears earlier in logged hypotheses/plans. Causal-fault file localization remains the primary objective mediator.

required_concepts_for_full_match: identify the authoritative interface/schema boundary or changed contract
trace multiple producers/consumers/call sites coupled to that boundary
plan a coherent multi-site update rather than isolated symptom patch
include regression/integration verification across the boundary
partial_match_examples: mentions finding callers/consumers but not coherent contract propagation
updates one affected site while explicitly recognizing more coupled sites remain
nonmatch_examples: surface patch to one failing assertion with no interface/dependency reasoning
generic run-tests-first plan without schema/coupling hypothesis

required_concepts_for_full_match: distinguish source-of-truth state from derived/cache/index state
identify the mutation/update after which derived state becomes stale
verify mutation followed by a dependent read/query
partial_match_examples: suspects cache/staleness but does not connect it to source mutation
proposes recompute without identifying the dependency lifecycle
nonmatch_examples: change read-side output while leaving stale-state mechanism untouched

required_concepts_for_full_match: identify exceptional/failure path that bypasses or misorders cleanup
verify both success and failure paths
partial_match_examples: spots missing cleanup but not lifecycle ordering or failure condition
adds cleanup without checking success/failure symmetry
nonmatch_examples: change test expectation without restoring lifecycle invariant

scoring.FULL_MATCH: all required conceptual obligations are substantively present in the logged hypothesis/plan before protected success
scoring.PARTIAL_MATCH: at least one family-specific causal concept is present but full procedure is not
scoring.NO_MATCH: no family-specific causal procedure is present
scoring.AMBIGUOUS: trace text is insufficient for reliable classification

event_order_metric: ordinal of first FULL_MATCH event; if none before termination, censor+1
blinding: family_id is never shown to solving arms
scorer reads only the logged event prefix being classified, not later agent reasoning
scorer may use evaluator-known family_id for classification after execution
H1a primary claim never depends solely on this subjective mediator
claim_boundary: Secondary descriptive/attribution support only in H1a; promotion to a primary mediator requires a separate prospective protocol with reliability assessment.
